Hi Sara — appreciate the quick note and glad the perf signals are looking good. We can do the three-week extension and put a simple protection in place for early termination. Two straightforward options that map to how other pilots have closed at scale: 

Option A — Timebox extension (no extra credits):
- Add 21 calendar days to the pilot.
- Price impact: none for time-only extension.
- Early-termination protection: If Olive terminates within the added 21 days, we offer a prorated credit equal to 50% of the unused days' equivalent token allocation (applied to a future purchase or refund at your choice).

Option B — Credit top-up (preferred for predictability):
- Add a one-time credit bucket equivalent to 21 days of the current average daily consumption at a 10% discounted rate.
- Early-termination protection: If terminated early, 75% of the remaining credit is refundable as a credit on future invoices (no cash refunds without finance approval).

Practical notes:
- Both options preserve the current SLA and access to our dedicated support channel for the pilot.
- Legal prefers an amendment that references the existing SOW and DocuSign for signatures. I've attached a draft amendment and a one-line SOW estimate for procurement.

If you prefer, we can default to Option A and I’ll add the prorated early-termination clause to the amendment; if Olive wants the predictability of fixed consumption, go with B. Tell me which path and I’ll loop in Legal to turn this into a 1-pg amendment + DocuSign.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
